acceptanceCriteria: Each language plugin defines what a changed unit with no selectable test is, and AFP-V0-020 (or a successor requirement) names such a unit in `plan.unknown` with reason `NO_SELECTABLE_TEST` for every supported language.
One test per plugin shows a changed untested unit turning the plan UNKNOWN and an unchanged untested unit leaving it BOUNDED.
`docs/specs/affected-plan-v0.md` drops the non-Go failure-mode gap and `REQUIREMENTS.tsv` is regenerated.
body: Filed 2026-09-23 from the V1-0187 review (SHOULD-FIX 2). AFP-V0-020 names a changed Go package with no tests in `plan.unknown` (`NO_SELECTABLE_TEST`), but the rule is limited to `go:` units. A changed TypeScript, Ruby, Rust, Kotlin or .NET source unit that no test unit reaches still vanishes from selected, excluded and unknown with scope BOUNDED. The spec records this only as a failure-mode gap.

completion.reason: Completed 2026-09-23 by PR #122 (merge 01b6804). Criterion 1: AFP-V0-020 now defines a changed unit with no selectable test per plugin through a rule table in select.go: Go treats a package without its own _test.go files as untested, and every other ecosystem uses reverse-import test reachability computed once per graph in graph.go; such a unit is named in plan.unknown with NO_SELECTABLE_TEST. Criterion 2: conformance_test.go adds a solo-unit case for every plugin: editing solo makes the plan UNKNOWN and names solo, editing core leaves it BOUNDED; the case fails for all seven non-Go plugins on the old rule. Deviation flagged on the PR and accepted by the owner's merge: the Playwright adapter leaves a helper unit with no spec BOUNDED, and V1-0211 decides how it reports one. Criterion 3: affected-plan-v0.md drops the non-Go failure-mode gap and records the Playwright gap; REQUIREMENTS.tsv regenerated. AFP-V0-020 proposed intent was amended; the owner's merge of PR #122 is its human review. Binding sealed at .corvint/changes/ace0a96bd5ffcfa2af8013e23a1cf3220b46c24f.cem.json (39 of 39 hunks supported). Evidence digests: sha256 at 01b6804 of the sealed CEM, select.go, conformance_test.go and affected-plan-v0.md. NOT_RUN: make gate (owner focused-verification policy).

title: affected: changed non-Go source units with no reaching test unit are still silently omitted
